messages:
mika: Thinking of switching my fantasy captain after that OT scramble. Who else is scrambling for waivers?
dan: Yep. Dropped my captain for Matthews this morning, hope that sticks.
alejandra: Wait are we doing coinflip tie-breaker again? I still owe someone a beer from last season's coinflip loss :grimacing: 
coach-bot: LeagueBot: Waiver claim processed for @dan — Matthews added to roster.
samir: Also quick logistics — aftergame pizza? I can put in an order for the office. Poll: pepperoni / margherita / vegan. Any GF needs?
olivia: pepperoni for me please.
jamal: vegan pls (thanks)
mika: margherita, and can we get extra basil please.
alejandra: That penalty call still haunts me. Anyone clip it? refs robbed the overtime. :angry:
dan: I recorded it on the stream, uploading now. Will drop in #shared once done.
olivia: Uploaded at 00:47:31, link in #shared. Slow-mo looks like contact but ugh.
samir: Pizza order I'll run from Joe's:
```
2 large pepperoni
1 margherita
1 vegan with cauliflower crust
extra napkins
```
If anyone needs GF tell me by 8:15.
mika: Heads for the coinflip from me. Also trade deadline reminder — swaps close at 9pm.
coach-bot: Reminder: Trade window closes in 45 minutes. Please confirm all approvals.
jamal: If we tie, coinflip at halftime? low-key want the drama.
alejandra: halftime coinflip sounds like a terrible and perfect plan. :joy:
samir: I'll bring sodas. Who's in for cleaning up after the pizza? small volunteer roster appreciated.
dan: I can stay 10 mins to help. gotta dash to a call after.
mika: I can do cleanup if someone covers the front-door run.
olivia: I got the door run. See yall in the lounge.
alejandra: Also congrats to @dan for the waiver win, nice steal. :trophy:
jamal: Grats dan. Now stop benching him next week.
mika: This thread is peak office sports chaos. Love it.
